data_note: All numbers in this file are invented for the handbook. Nothing here was measured on a real system.

environment.region: same AWS region as the ALB and ECS services
environment.load_generator: Locust script from chapter 61, one generator task
environment.test_data: synthetic users and projects, reset before each run

scenarios.name: peak
scenarios.traffic_profile: Same mix, rate taken from the busiest hour of last month's access logs

bottlenecks.evidence: Average task CPU peaked at 38% while p95 was 480 ms.
DB connections sat at 100 of 100 for about 8 minutes. Pool wait p95 was 310 ms. Previous run peaked at 62 connections.
bottlenecks.conclusion: Confirmed as the main cause. Release 2.4.0 raised the pool from 10 to 20 per task.

bottlenecks.hypothesis: Downstream slowness on the ALB path
bottlenecks.evidence: Target response time p95 was 470 ms, which matches the app-side p95. ALB 5XX from ELB was 5, so the load balancer is not the cause.

recommendations.action: Keep the total pool (tasks x pool size) below max_connections. Set the pool back to 10 per task, or put RDS Proxy in front of the database.
recommendations.expected_impact: Should remove the pool wait. Re-test to confirm the p95 falls back toward the previous 290 ms.

recommendations.action: Check the task list query for slow SQL. Shorter queries free connections sooner.
recommendations.expected_impact: Fewer connections held per request. Size of effect not yet measured.

recommendations.action: Do not add tasks as the first fix. More tasks would open more connections to the same 100-connection limit and could make p95 worse. Re-test after the database fix, then decide on task count.
recommendations.expected_impact: Avoids a fix that would not help. Revisit after the re-test.

risks_and_limitations: Only one task size and one task count were tested.
Peak traffic mix came from one month of access logs; real peaks may differ.
The load generator ran on one machine. Its own limits were not checked.
not_tested: Soak test (for memory growth over hours)
